question: How many mass shootings will the U.S. experience in December 2026?

calls.reasoning: GVA December counts: ~34 (2023), ~29-30 (2024), ~28 (2025), derived from Dec-1 vs year-end totals. 2026 GVA YTD is ~7% above 2025 (412 vs 384 at Nov 16). The resolving source (Mass Shooting Tracker, which also counts the shooter as a victim) tracks GVA closely: Oct 2026 ~41 vs GVA 42, Nov 1-16 ~24-26 vs GVA 18. Expected MST December is about 31-32 with SD ~7 (Poisson noise plus extra variance for volunteer tracking). No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi (harness search plus mine; Kalshi and bookmakers not searched separately). Caveat: MST JSON counts came via a summarizing fetch tool that sometimes truncated, so they are approximate.

- Event window: Dec 1 -> Dec 31 2026 per the criteria; as of 2026-11-18, 0% elapsed.
- GVA 2026 monthly (tweet, Nov 16 2026): Jan 25, Feb 28, Mar 40, Apr 34, May 36, Jun 43, Jul 69, Aug 46, Sep 31, Oct 42, Nov 1-16: 18. YTD 412 vs 384 at the same date in 2025 (+7%).
- MST 2026 JSON (summarizing fetch tool, approximate): Oct ~41, Nov 1-16 ~24-26, Sep ~27+ (possibly truncated), Aug ~51.
- GVA 2025: 380 at Dec 1 (WBAL, Dec 2025), 392 at Dec 15 (GVA tweet), 408 year-end (The Trace) -> Dec 2025 ~28 (GVA).
- GVA 2024: 474 at Dec 1, ~503-504 year-end -> Dec 2024 ~30. GVA 2023: 622 at Dec 1, ~656 year-end -> Dec ~34.
- Trend: 2025 was 41% below the 2021 record; 2026 is running slightly above 2025.
- The MST/GVA ratio varies by month: about 1.0 for Oct 2026, about 1.4 for early Nov 2026.
- December includes holiday weekends (Christmas, New Year's Eve), with clustering at month-end in 2025 (MST listed 12 incidents Dec 26-31 2025).
- Could not find: an exact MST December count for 2023-2025 (the fetch tool truncated the file), or any prediction market.
calls.reference_class: US December mass-shooting counts (4+ shot), GVA 2023-2025, scaled to the 2026 YTD trend and the MST/GVA ratio

calls.reasoning: Recent Decembers on this tracker were about 34, 45, 35 and 35 (2022-2025); the 2025 figure of 35 is consistent with the partial counts in two runs. The tracker counts about 1.2-1.3x GVA in December. Projected GVA December 2026 is about 30-31 (+7% YTD), giving a tracker count of about 36. Scaling October 2026 (~44) by December's usual 0.75-0.85 gives 33-37. Central estimate ~35.5 with SD ~7, plus a small downward pull because late-December entries may not be logged by Jan 1. No human market found.
calls.reconciliation: The main factual dispute was the December 2025 count on this tracker (Run 2: 27+ partial; Run 3: 35). Run 2's 27 covers only Dec 10-31, so it fits a full-month count of about 35; I accepted 35. The second dispute was the ratio of this tracker to GVA (Run 1: about 1.0 from October). December ratios from three years (1.3, 1.17, 1.25) and early November 2026 (1.4) support about 1.2, so I rejected Run 1's lower mean. Raw counts could not be checked beyond the dossiers because there was no web access on this run. Final mean is about 35.5 with SD about 7.

disagreements.verdict: Settled at ~35: the 27 covers only Dec 10-31, and the fetch tool missed earlier entries
Historical December ratios of 1.17-1.3 support ~1.2; October 2026 looks like an outlier
~35.5, from the reconciled ratio and the seasonal scaling of October
